title: Supercell 完成对《Merge Mansion》开发商 Metacore 的收购
content:
Supercell has completed its acquisition of Merge Mansion maker Metacore – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Supercell has completed its acquisition of Merge Mansion developer Metacore, which is now fully owned by the Finnish publisher.
Metacore announced the news in a
LinkedIn post
today, October 19, saying its game team has officially started as “Supercellians”.
Supercell – posting its own
welcome message
on LinkedIn – said the Merge Mansion team “has moved in”.
Merge Mansion will become part of Supercell’s game portfolio, with the team continuing to develop it with the aim of returning to its “chart-topping spot”.
Financial terms have not been disclosed, and the deal
had been expected to close at the end of September
.
Supercell is a long-term investor and partner to fellow Finnish firm Metacore. In January 2023, Metacore acquired failed Supercell soft launch game Everdale and attempted to rework and relaunch the game under its ownership, but killed the game in September 2024.
It then
announced plans to buy the rest of Metacore in May
, with CEO Ilkka Paananen saying he believes the game’s “best days are still ahead”.
Metacore has since
cut 159 staff at its Helsinki HQ
and closed its offices in Germany and Sweden.
Former Small Giant Games CEO Jose Saarniniemi
joined as general manager of Merge Mansion
in June.
Merge Mansion is
estimated to have earned around $490m since its 2020 launch, according to
AppMagic
.
